title: HydroFans
tagline: Conquer dehydration and decentralize your water intake data powered by Starknet!
description: Hydrofans is here to revolutionize hydration! Did you know that 75% of adults in the U.S. suffer from chronic dehydration, leading to serious health issues and skyrocketing medical costs? Hydrofans tackles this problem head-on by leveraging StarkNet to track your daily water intake with precision and security. Our dynamic app offers personalized hydration goals, an interactive calendar to visualize your progress, and vibrant reminders to keep you on track. Join the hydration revolution with Hydrofans – because staying healthy and hydrated has never been this exciting!
how_its_made:
### How It's Made - Hydrofans

- **Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet - Vision API**:
  - Utilized for recognizing and accurately measuring the volume of water intake through images. This technology powers HydroBot, an intelligent assistant that tracks and logs your water consumption seamlessly.
  
- **Cairo**:
  - Employed to develop the smart contracts on StarkNet. These contracts securely store user data, track daily water intake, and monitor hydration streaks, ensuring accuracy and preservation of your hydration history on the blockchain.
  
- **React**:
  - The front-end framework used to build the dynamic and responsive user interface of Hydrofans. React's component-based architecture allows for a modular and maintainable codebase.
  
- **Next.js**:
  - Leveraged for server-side rendering and static site generation, enhancing the performance and SEO of the Hydrofans app. Next.js also facilitates seamless routing and integration with React.
  
- **Tailwind CSS**:
  - Implemented for styling the application. Tailwind's utility-first approach allows for rapid and consistent design, ensuring a sleek and modern look throughout the Hydrofans app.
